Subject: Intro + kickoff: ClearView onboarding (model shortlist & sizing)

Hi team,

Quick intro: ClearView (Emily) signed the SOW and want to start the onboarding sprint next week. High-level asks from the discovery call: clinical note summarization, entity extraction for billing codes, and a patient Q&A assistant. They expect peak concurrent sessions ~40, avg session length ~240 tokens of user input + model outputs.

Can we pull together a model shortlist and a token/latency budget to share with Emily by EOD? Key constraints:
- Latency SLO: 300ms p50 for short Q&A; 800ms p95 acceptable for longer summarization calls.
- Context needs: clinical notes up to 12k tokens in worst-case, but typical is 2–3k.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement flagged per-token costs to stay under their forecast (see deal notes in HubSpot).

Grace/Ben — can you lead the sizing + recommended model variants? Mina, please advise if any quantization or KV cache tweaks would materially change latency/cost for the long-context path.

Emily — looped you in so we can align on expectations; feel free to correct any numbers above.

Thanks,
Vivek

Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff: ClearView onboarding (model shortlist & sizing) — shortlist + sizing notes

Folks — see the initial model shortlist and a conservative token/latency mix below. I also attached clearview_token_profile.csv (sampled distribution from discovery).

High-level recommendations (shortlist):
1) small-chat variant (cost-first): LlamaX-7B-quant (int4)
   - Use case: patient Q&A, short completions.
   - Context: up to 4k tokens.
   - Est. latency: p50 ~120ms (single-turn), p95 ~260ms.
   - Cost: lowest per-token.
2) medium summarizer (balanced latency/cost): Falcon-40B-instruct (pruned+int8)
   - Use case: structured summarization, entity extraction for billing.
   - Context: up to 12k with chunk+stitch; prefer prefix caching for repeated sections.
   - Est. latency: p50 ~380ms (for 2–3k context), p95 ~760ms (12k workflows with chunking overhead).
   - Cost: mid-range.
3) long-context specialist (quality-first): Redstone-70B-long (sparse attention hybrid)
   - Use case: full clinical note summarization at scale; best for high accuracy.
   - Context: native 32k support.
   - Est. latency: p50 ~820ms (for 12k), p95 ~1500ms — expect cost premium.

Token mix (based on ClearView discovery):
- Interactive Q&A (60% of calls): avg 240 user tokens / 120 model tokens.
- Short summarization (30%): avg 800 user tokens / 600 model tokens.
- Full note summarization (10%): avg 9k user tokens / 1.5k model tokens (chunked).

Projected daily token volume (initial):
- Active users: 200 daily active users
- Sessions/day: 600 sessions -> ~1.2M tokens/day (mixed model routing)
- Peak concurrent requests: 40 (as noted)

Operational recommendations:
- Routing: route Q&A to LlamaX-7B-quant, summarization to Falcon-40B-instruct, fallback to Redstone-70B-long for critical accuracy requests.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated note headers and patient context; expect 10–20% token reduction for summarization flows.
- Batching: configure adaptive batching at the Dedicated pool for summarization windows (batch windows 10–30ms) to keep p95 latency within target without blowing cost.
- Quantization: Mina — if Redstone-70B-long can accept int8 without quality regression for billing entities, that could cut cost ~30% on long runs.

Attachments: clearview_token_profile.csv, latency_budget_v0.1.pdf (draft approach to measure p50/p95).

Action items (today):
- Grace/Avery: pick kickoff time slot (Grace already proposed Thu 10am PT).
- Mina: quick check on int8 viability for Redstone (ETA: EOD tomorrow).
- Ben: run a quick lab test for 12k chunked summarization and share latency histogram (ETA: tomorrow morning).

Happy to walk through numbers on the call.

Thanks,
Ben
